meta.title: Vendor submits a modified bid (re-counter) against a buyer counter offer
gaps: Perform the vendor-side Modify Counter Offer flow: choose Decline, select Modify Counter Offer, enter ₹85, add a remark, and submit the modified bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Perform the vendor-side Modify Counter Offer flow: choose Decline, select Modify Counter Offer, enter ₹85, add a remark, and submit the modified bid.

steps.note: Open an existing event selected for a pending counter offer.
Continue in the vendor persona’s supplier portal.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer is shown.
Verify that the vendor sees the counter-offer banner or pending counter-offer state.

args.need: complete the vendor-side Modify Counter Offer flow by choosing Decline, selecting Modify Counter Offer, entering ₹85, adding a remark, and submitting the modified bid

steps.note: The catalog has no step for modifying a counter offer with a remark and submitting it.
Verify the vendor view shows the expected modified-counter-offer tag.
Return to the buyer’s event page to inspect the updated QCS.
Open the buyer’s comparison grid for the event.
Verify the buyer’s QCS shows the modified bid value of ₹85.
